findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 6 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 31 questions numbered 1-31; by section: 6.2 2, 6.2.1 2, 6.3 1, 6.4 4, 6.5.1 1, 6.5.2 2, 6.6 1, 6.6.1 1, 6.7 3, 6.8.1 1, 6.8.2 2, 6.9 1, 6.9.1 1, 6.9.2 1, 6.10 5, 6.11 3.

Section-II style 5-mark parts covering A.P. terms and selection of terms, A.M.s, the derivation of the arithmetic sum formula and problems on it, G.P. terms and properties, G.M.s and the A.M.-G.M. relation, the derivation of the geometric sum formula, A.G.P. sums to n terms and to infinity, H.P. and H.M.s, the sigma formulas for sum k and sum k^2 by telescoping, series sums with sigma, and real-life problems. Every step and result was checked by computation (check6_long.py); the book's printed slips (backward-sum term l + 2d, a_l, A.G.P. sign errors) are not used.
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
